title: BOSH Package Spec
description:
Package Spec for BOSH Releases

Docs: https://bosh.io/docs/packages/

dependencies.description: List of other packages that this package depends on.

files.description: List of files that this package contains, either explicitly and/or through pattern-matching.

excluded_files.description: List of files to be excluded from the package, either explicitly and/or through pattern-matching. Applies on top of `files`.

no_compression.description: Whether compression is disabled for the individual package tarball.
